name: Egerbacher
beschreibung:
Picturesquely located in Schwoich, the historic Gasthof Egerbacher welcomes guests with warm Tyrolean hospitality and welcoming family charm. The property is widely known for its excellent local cooking and cosy ambiance.

The peaceful surroundings are ideal for scenic walks, cycling tours, and excursions to the Kaiser mountains or the historic fortress town of Kufstein.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Egerbacher in Schwoich offers traditional Tyrolean cuisine and rural tranquility in the scenic Kufsteinerland.
